🌐 Multiplayer

Before you play online
  • Other players in a room are strangers who choose their own names. There is no chat or voice.
  • The game shares your player name, car and position with the players in your room.
  • That data passes through third-party public relay servers, which can see your IP address.
  • Please don't use your real name or personal details as your player name.
  • You can report or block anyone, and the room host can remove players.
